providers.name: Polar
providers.authentication: Raw-body supplier validateEvent or Polar Webhooks wrapper with configured signing secret
providers.beforeEnforcement: Production list includes newly announced 3.134.178.243; refresh lists and verify both signing-secret generations with owning SDK; observe before enforcing

Compare source IP against the relevant published environment list in observation before a separately reviewed enforcing change.
